description: What ONE named shop sells right now, read live off the shop's own declared catalog: per process, every stock with its own colours and thicknesses, and every finish with the stocks it goes on and its colours. No quote needed, nobody is contacted, and the user's board does not change. Call it when the user asks what a specific maker offers ("what colours of acrylic does SendCutSend have?", "what else do they do?"). One shop name covers every process it sells. A stock listed with no colours means the shop does not list colours for it, never that it has none. Never answer such a question from the offers on a quote (they show what was offered for one ask, not everything the shop sells) and never from memory.

material.description: Narrow the list to one material or family ("acrylic", "mild steel")

shop.description: The shop as the user or the offer cards name it ("SendCutSend", "sendcutsend")

name: get_shop_offerings
title: What a shop offers
